adjudication.rationale: The diff adds new behavior around `cook_method` (creation sets `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` in `TopicEmbed.import`, and `Post#cook` bypasses cooking when `raw_html`). On update, `TopicEmbed.import` revises the existing post via `PostRevisor#revise!` without explicitly asserting that `cook_method` remains `:raw_html`. The spec `"Supports updating the post"` only checks `post.cooked =~ /new contents/`, which would still pass even if the post were re-cooked via the normal pipeline, so it doesn’t meaningfully test the raw_html preservation. Similarly, there is no test asserting the SHA1 guard prevents revision when content is unchanged, nor that repeated imports keep `TopicEmbed.count` at 1 and don’t create duplicate topics/embeds. These are concrete, diff-grounded test gaps for newly added logic, not a demonstrated runtime defect in the code shown.
